purpose: Measured finite synthetic fixture correspondence; no general image-quality, noise-reliability or physical recovery claim.
reference_semantics: Independent stored-observation complex fit for every case, including off-model; never generating parameters as off-model truth.
array_encoding: C-order bytes SHA-256 with explicit dtype/shape; values are JSON real numbers; complex arrays carry separate real and imag arrays.

renderer.command: MPLBACKEND=Agg MPLCONFIGDIR=artifacts/illumination-execution/figures/mplconfig uv run --offline --no-project --python .venv/bin/python --with matplotlib==3.11.2 --with numpy==2.5.3 python artifacts/illumination-execution/figures/render.py

comparison.parameter_axes: linear phase and modulation, logarithmic direct relative residual

reconstruction.imaginary_diagnostic: maximum absolute imaginary component recorded numerically; image error includes both real and imaginary components
